taiwan_aviation.headline: 國內線午後陸續恢復 民航局協調加班與放大機型
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國內線航班午後陸續恢復後，交通部民用航空局協調航空公司加開班機或放大機型，共計25架次，其中澎湖航線17架次、金門航線8架次，提供2,251個座位。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Domestic Flights Resume as CAA Taiwan Coordinates 25 Capacity Increases
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Domestic flights in Taiwan gradually resumed during the afternoon, the Civil Aeronautics Administration said. It coordinated with airlines to add flights or use larger aircraft for a total of 25 flight operations: 17 on Penghu routes and eight on Kinmen routes, providing 2,251 seats.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣虎航發動機檢查逾期遭民航局裁罰20萬元
taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部民用航空局最新公佈的違規事件裁罰資訊指出，臺灣虎航一架A320-271N飛機的二號發動機燃燒室延遲缺點檢查管制逾期，依民航法遭裁罰新臺幣20萬元，並被要求立即改善。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Tigerair fined NT$200,000 over overdue engine inspection
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: The Civil Aviation Administration’s latest published violation information says Taiwan Tigerair was fined NT$200,000 under the Civil Aviation Act after an inspection control deadline for the No. 2 engine’s combustion-chamber deferred defect passed. The authority also required immediate improvement.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚抵臺協助繁殖
taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚Harris來臺。Harris於美國時間10月26日搭乘貨機自達拉斯機場起飛，並於臺灣時間27日晚間10時26分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。長榮航空表示，航程約18個小時，休士頓動物園副園長及保衛員也隨行照料。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air transports male bongo antelope to Taiwan for breeding
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air transported a male bongo antelope named Harris to Taiwan. Harris departed Dallas Airport aboard a cargo aircraft on Oct. 26 U.S. time and arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 10:26 p.m. Taiwan time on Oct. 27. EVA Air said the flight took about 18 hours, with the Houston Zoo's deputy director and an animal-care staff member accompanying and caring for him.

international_aviation.headline: Electra EL2 曼哈頓直升機停機坪固定翼起降示範
international_aviation.summary: Electra 於 2026 年 10 月 26 日駕駛其混合動力 EL2 Goldfinch 示範機，降落並起飛於紐約下城的 Downtown Skyport 直升機停機坪，這是該公司宣稱的首次固定翼飛機在無垂直起降能力下使用直升機坪。
international_aviation.headline_en: Electra EL2 completes fixed‑wing landing and take‑off at Manhattan heliport, demonstrating ultra‑short take‑off capability
international_aviation.summary_en: On 26 October 2026 Electra flew its hybrid‑electric EL2 Goldfinch demonstrator into Downtown Skyport, a waterfront heliport in Lower Manhattan, and performed a landing and take‑off, which the company says is the first fixed‑wing operation at the site without vertical‑takeoff capability.

international_aviation.headline_en: Atlantic Airways signs firm order for two A320neo jets to advance all‑neo fleet goal
international_aviation.summary_en: On 27 October 2026 Atlantic Airways, the national carrier of the Faroe Islands, signed a firm order with Airbus for two A320neo aircraft, furthering its plan to transition to an all‑neo fleet.

new_information: Atlantic Airways placed a firm order with Airbus for two A320neo aircraft on 27 October 2026.
Atlantic Airways aims to operate an exclusively A320neo fleet in the near future.
Atlantic Airways currently operates two A320-200s and two A320neos from Vágar Airport (VSE).
The carrier now has four A320neo aircraft on order as part of a long‑term investment plan up to DKK 2 billion ($298 million).
The two newly ordered A320neo aircraft are scheduled for delivery early next decade.
